Demo

Download the demo to try out the game with limits of:
  • First 4 levels
  • 2 Buildings
  • 1 Runeword(An, Ce, D)
  • 1 craftable weapon - Basic sword with 5 upgradable sword levels.
  • An early version of the hero xp/stats/talents system
